{{Top|leg}}
The '''assassination module''' was an advanced upgrade to be used primarily by [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. Not much was known about the inner-workings of these modules, except for the boost in ranged weapons skills.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only [[HK-47]] is able to equip this item.
